messages:
nina: quick proposal  add a short 'canary rollforward' appendix to Dedicated Provisioning docs. includes: decision tree, minimal CLI/SDK commands, and an example autoscale YAML. want small, copy/pasteable bits only. cc @paul @isha.

paul: +1. please show explicit decision points: canary fail -> try rollforward to alt pool in same region -> if none, revert traffic to previous model version -> escalate. include exact CLI commands for each step.

nina: draft decision-tree (one-liner bullets):
- detect canary failure (p95 or error-rate threshold)
- attempt rollforward to alternate pool: `redwood-cli provision rollforward --id <id> --pool <pool>`
- if rollforward unavailable, revert traffic: `redwood-cli routing set --id <id> --version <prev>`
- reassign tenant via SDK: `client.Provisionings.Update(tenant_id, {reserved_pool: "prev_pool"})`
- run smoke tests and monitor p95 for 10m; escalate if still failing

isha: add example autoscale YAML and note cooldowns to prevent flapping. small note about eviction_grace_period and isolation_label. link to eng-sre runbook for preemption thresholds.

nina: autoscale snippet to paste:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 6
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  policy: cpu
```

docs-ci-bot: docs build OK for PR #4581. 1 link suggestion: point /ops/infra/terragrunt/provisioning to README.md.

paul: thanks, nif. i'll do a quick docs review after you push the PR.
